title: Hannah Ferrier and Captain Sandy Yawn Rekindle Friendship: A Shocking Below Deck Reunion Fans Didn’t See Coming
htmlContent:
The Below Deck Mediterranean universe has been subject to numerous dramas, feuds, and farewells. Still, none were as polarizing as the disagreement between Chief Stew Hannah Ferrier and Captain Sandy Yawn. Their relationship, which had been close before, famously deteriorated on-screen, leading fans to assume it would last forever. The assumption has been thrown out.

A Three-Hour Reunion That Changed Everything

Hannah Ferrier stated on Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen that Captain Sandy and she have established a genuine reconnection, not just civil peace. Ferrier recounted a deeply felt three-hour conversation in Sydney, during which Sandy met Hannah's husband and young daughter. "Sandy and I sat down and had a really good chat when she was in Sydney," Ferrier told Cohen. "She met my daughter, my husband… it was a three-hour conversation." The emotional impact of that discussion was sufficient to bring an end to years of tension. Captain Sandy started the meeting by reaching out and initiating the sit-down. According to Ferrier, the gesture was surprising and deeply appreciated. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihdaQMb46lc

No More Grudges: Why Time Healed This Rift

Ferrier emphasized that the time that has passed since their dramatic fallout has made her more willing to reconcile. "I don't like holding on to grudges. I don't like having bad energy in my body," she said, reflecting a more mature, emotionally grounded mindset than the fiery stew viewers once knew. Their disagreement in Season 5 involved the now-infamous incident where Ferrier was dismissed after being found with undisclosed anti-anxiety medication on board. This situation played out harshly on camera. Despite fans quickly taking sides, both women received criticism and support equally. Ferrier has been outspoken about the dismissal's emotional impact on her career and mental health. Two years ago, while on Watch What Happens Live with Andy, Yawn was asked which chief stew she would want to work with again. Her response, which included Hannah, shocked viewers at the time. “I would work with any of them again, even Hannah.”

Real Bond Beneath the Drama

Despite its explosive end, Ferrier maintained that their professional relationship had a foundation of respect and connection. "Sandy and I — despite what you saw on camera — actually had something real during those years," she said. "That's kind of why I was so hurt and disappointed." This isn't a generic PR-style truce. The ferry now FaceTimes Captain Sandy during flights, and they are planning upcoming public appearances together, something that would have been unthinkable just a year ago.   "I FaceTime her when I'm on a plane, and we chat. It's amazing," Ferrier shared.

Selective Forgiveness: No Reunion with Malia White

Ferrier clarified that her rekindled friendship with Sandy does not mean she is ready to reconcile with everyone from her Below Deck past. Ferrier said bluntly when asked if she would be open to receiving a similar olive branch from former bosun Malia White. "If Malia reached out, I'm good."
This distinction highlights the personal growth and sincerity behind their reconnection, making the reunion with Sandy even more significant.
Malia White has made multiple public statements about the incident. She has expressed regret for her handling of the situation, specifically the way she reported Hannah's medication, but not for the act itself. Malia has stated that she felt it was her duty to report the medication for safety and legal reasons, especially since they were cabin-mates. She was concerned about her own licensing. She has stated that she wants to move forward from the incident and focus on her career. Emphasizing that she has no regrets or anxiety about the show and has learned from it.

Public Appearances and What's Next for the Dynamic Duo

Ferrier and Captain Sandy will be back on stage soon with scheduled joint appearances, but they won't be on opposing sides in a tense yacht briefing this time. Hannah and Sandy will be reunited publicly at City Cru Live, a new event series organized by City Cruises. They are both excited about working together again, a prospect that seemed impossible a year ago. According to US Weekly, they are planning more joint performances, including panels and fan events. The symbolism of their rekindled relationship speaks volumes to longtime viewers.

Final Thoughts: Redemption and Growth in the Below Deck Universe

The Hannah Ferrier and Captain Sandy Yawn friendship renewal illustrates the possibility of growth, maturity, and forgiveness in even the most volatile reality TV settings. One of the most captivating human narratives in the history of the Below Deck franchise can be found in their story arc, which goes from respect to rupture and back to reconciliation. Fans who have observed their ups and downs unfold over multiple seasons will find this reunion to be something scarce in reality television: closure, evolution, and maybe even a new chapter. Keep an eye out for this yacht - it hasn't sailed yet.
